pergunta: Qual foi a receita total em 2017?
sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS receita
FROM dw.orders o
JOIN dw.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp <  '2018-01-01';

pergunta: Quantos pedidos foram entregues no último mês?
sql:
-- "ultimo mes" = agosto/2018 (data de referencia dos dados: 2018-08-31)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS pedidos_entregues
FROM dw.orders o
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-08-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp <  '2018-09-01';

pergunta: Qual o ticket médio deste ano?
sql:
-- "este ano" = jan a ago/2018
SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.price) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) AS ticket_medio
FROM dw.orders o
JOIN dw.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp <  '2018-09-01';

pergunta: Qual o tempo médio de entrega no último trimestre?
sql:
-- "ultimo trimestre" = jun a ago/2018
SELECT ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (o.order_delivered_customer_date - o.order_purchase_timestamp)) / 86400)::numeric, 1)
       AS tempo_medio_entrega_dias
FROM dw.orders o
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
  AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-06-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp <  '2018-09-01';

pergunta: Quantos pedidos tivemos na Black Friday de 2017?
sql:
-- Black Friday 2017 = 24/11/2017
SELECT COUNT(*)                                                AS pedidos_feitos,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered')    AS pedidos_entregues
FROM dw.orders o
WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-11-24'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp <  '2017-11-25';
observacao: Pergunta sobre 'pedidos tivemos' mostra pedidos feitos e entregues para deixar claro o critério.

pergunta: Compare a receita do Sudeste com a do Nordeste em 2018.
sql:
SELECT c.customer_region              AS regiao,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2)        AS receita,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id)     AS pedidos
FROM dw.orders o
JOIN dw.customers c    ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN dw.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp <  '2018-09-01'
  AND c.customer_region IN ('Sudeste', 'Nordeste')
GROUP BY c.customer_region
ORDER BY receita DESC;

pergunta: Como foi a receita de 2018 em relação a 2017?
sql:
-- Compara o mesmo intervalo (jan a ago) dos dois anos
WITH por_ano AS (
    SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp)::int AS ano,
           SUM(oi.price)                                      AS receita
    FROM dw.orders o
    JOIN dw.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
      AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01'
      AND o.order_purchase_timestamp <  '2018-09-01'
      AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) <= 8
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT ano,
       ROUND(receita, 2)                                                    AS receita_jan_ago,
       ROUND(100 * (receita / LAG(receita) OVER (ORDER BY ano) - 1), 2)     AS variacao_pct
FROM por_ano
ORDER BY ano;

pergunta: Qual o ticket médio por forma de pagamento?
sql:
-- Receita agregada por pedido ANTES de juntar com pagamentos (evita multiplicar linhas)
WITH receita_pedido AS (
    SELECT o.order_id, SUM(oi.price) AS receita
    FROM dw.orders o
    JOIN dw.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
      AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-09-01'
    GROUP BY o.order_id
)
SELECT p.payment_type             AS forma_pagamento,
       COUNT(*)                   AS pedidos,
       ROUND(AVG(r.receita), 2)   AS ticket_medio
FROM receita_pedido r
JOIN dw.order_payments p ON p.order_id = r.order_id AND p.payment_sequential = 1
GROUP BY p.payment_type
ORDER BY pedidos DESC;

pergunta: Qual o percentual de entregas no prazo por região?
sql:
SELECT c.customer_region AS regiao,
       COUNT(*)          AS pedidos_entregues,
       ROUND(100.0 * AVG((o.order_delivered_customer_date::date <= o.order_estimated_delivery_date::date)::int), 2)
                         AS entregas_no_prazo_pct
FROM dw.orders o
JOIN dw.customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
  AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-09-01'
GROUP BY c.customer_region
ORDER BY entregas_no_prazo_pct;

pergunta: Qual o peso do frete sobre a receita em cada região?
metricas: Percentual do frete sobre a receita
sql:
SELECT c.customer_region                                   AS regiao,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2)                             AS receita,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.freight_value), 2)                     AS frete,
       ROUND(100 * SUM(oi.freight_value) / SUM(oi.price), 2) AS frete_sobre_receita_pct
FROM dw.orders o
JOIN dw.customers c    ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN dw.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-09-01'
GROUP BY c.customer_region
ORDER BY frete_sobre_receita_pct DESC;

pergunta: O tempo de entrega melhorou ao longo dos trimestres?
sql:
-- Apenas trimestres completos (2018-T3 so teria julho e agosto)
SELECT TO_CHAR(DATE_TRUNC('quarter', o.order_purchase_timestamp), 'YYYY-"T"Q') AS trimestre,
       COUNT(*)                                                                AS pedidos,
       ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (o.order_delivered_customer_date - o.order_purchase_timestamp)) / 86400)::numeric, 1)
                                                                               AS tempo_medio_entrega_dias
FROM dw.orders o
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
  AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp <  '2018-07-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

pergunta: Como evoluiu a taxa de cancelamento por mês?
sql:
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp)::date AS mes,
       COUNT(*)                                              AS pedidos_feitos,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')) / COUNT(*), 2)
                                                             AS taxa_cancelamento_pct
FROM dw.orders o
WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp <  '2018-09-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

pergunta: Quais são as 10 categorias com maior receita?
sql:
SELECT p.product_category_name     AS categoria,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2)     AS receita,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id)  AS pedidos
FROM dw.orders o
JOIN dw.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN dw.products p     ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-09-01'
GROUP BY p.product_category_name
ORDER BY receita DESC
LIMIT 10;

pergunta: Quem foram os 10 vendedores com maior receita em 2018?
sql:
SELECT oi.seller_id,
       s.seller_city               AS cidade,
       s.seller_state              AS uf,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2)     AS receita,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id)  AS pedidos
FROM dw.orders o
JOIN dw.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN dw.sellers s      ON s.seller_id = oi.seller_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp <  '2018-09-01'
GROUP BY oi.seller_id, s.seller_city, s.seller_state
ORDER BY receita DESC
LIMIT 10;
observacao: Vendedores não têm nome no dataset; identifique pelo seller_id e cidade/UF.

pergunta: Quais estados têm mais atrasos nas entregas?
sql:
SELECT c.customer_state AS uf,
       COUNT(*)         AS pedidos_entregues,
       ROUND(100.0 * AVG((o.order_delivered_customer_date::date > o.order_estimated_delivery_date::date)::int), 2)
                        AS pedidos_atrasados_pct,
       ROUND(AVG(o.order_delivered_customer_date::date - o.order_estimated_delivery_date::date)
             FILTER (WHERE o.order_delivered_customer_date::date > o.order_estimated_delivery_date::date), 1)
                        AS atraso_medio_dias
FROM dw.orders o
JOIN dw.customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
  AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-09-01'
GROUP BY c.customer_state
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100
ORDER BY pedidos_atrasados_pct DESC
LIMIT 10;
observacao: Estados com menos de 100 pedidos são excluídos para evitar percentuais instáveis.

pergunta: Quais categorias têm a pior avaliação dos clientes?
sql:
-- Nota e categoria agregadas por pedido antes do JOIN (evita multiplicar linhas)
WITH nota_pedido AS (
    SELECT r.order_id, AVG(r.review_score) AS nota
    FROM dw.order_reviews r
    GROUP BY r.order_id
),
categoria_pedido AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT oi.order_id, p.product_category_name AS categoria
    FROM dw.order_items oi
    JOIN dw.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
)
SELECT cp.categoria,
       COUNT(*)                 AS pedidos_avaliados,
       ROUND(AVG(np.nota), 2)   AS nota_media
FROM categoria_pedido cp
JOIN nota_pedido np ON np.order_id = cp.order_id
JOIN dw.orders o    ON o.order_id = cp.order_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-09-01'
GROUP BY cp.categoria
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100
ORDER BY nota_media
LIMIT 10;
observacao: Categorias com menos de 100 pedidos avaliados são excluídas.

pergunta: Qual foi a taxa de churn por região no último trimestre?
sql:
-- Periodo: jun a ago/2018 | base: clientes que compraram de dez/2017 a mai/2018
WITH base AS (
    SELECT c.customer_unique_id, MIN(c.customer_region) AS regiao
    FROM dw.orders o
    JOIN dw.customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
      AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-12-01'
      AND o.order_purchase_timestamp <  '2018-06-01'
    GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
),
compraram_no_periodo AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id
    FROM dw.orders o
    JOIN dw.customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
      AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-06-01'
      AND o.order_purchase_timestamp <  '2018-09-01'
)
SELECT b.regiao,
       COUNT(*)                                             AS clientes_base,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.customer_unique_id IS NULL) AS clientes_churn,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.customer_unique_id IS NULL) / COUNT(*), 2) AS churn_pct
FROM base b
LEFT JOIN compraram_no_periodo p ON p.customer_unique_id = b.customer_unique_id
GROUP BY b.regiao
ORDER BY churn_pct DESC;
observacao: Churn alto (~97-99%) é esperado: o marketplace é de compra única. Explicar ao usuário.

pergunta: Qual foi a taxa de churn de vendedores por região no último trimestre?
sql:
-- Periodo: jun a ago/2018 | base: vendedores que venderam de dez/2017 a mai/2018
-- Regiao do VENDEDOR (seller_region), nao do cliente
WITH base AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT oi.seller_id
    FROM dw.orders o
    JOIN dw.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
      AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-12-01'
      AND o.order_purchase_timestamp <  '2018-06-01'
),
venderam_no_periodo AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT oi.seller_id
    FROM dw.orders o
    JOIN dw.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
      AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-06-01'
      AND o.order_purchase_timestamp <  '2018-09-01'
)
SELECT s.seller_region                              AS regiao,
       COUNT(*)                                     AS vendedores_base,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE v.seller_id IS NULL)  AS vendedores_churn,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE v.seller_id IS NULL) / COUNT(*), 2) AS churn_vendedores_pct
FROM base b
JOIN dw.sellers s                 ON s.seller_id = b.seller_id
LEFT JOIN venderam_no_periodo v   ON v.seller_id = b.seller_id
GROUP BY s.seller_region
ORDER BY churn_vendedores_pct DESC;
observacao: Pergunta usada como exemplo principal no documento da E1. Regiões com poucos vendedores na base (ex.: Norte com 2) geram percentuais instáveis: mostre a base junto e alerte o usuário.
